branding.title: Cursor Community Welcome
branding.subtitle: A configurable animated welcome screen for events and workshops

sections.text: Welcome to Cursor Community Welcome — a configurable animated screen for events and workshops.
The welcome screen opens with the Cursor logo, community brand, heading, live date, and a floating particle background — ready for presentation.
The brand line names the community or chapter, and the heading carries the event title beneath it.
The date can follow today automatically, or you can lock in a custom event date from the editor.
Edit, Preview, and Share sit in the corner so hosts can customize, present, or send a link without leaving the screen.
Press E or click Edit to open the sidebar. Change brand, title, date, and replay interval, add up to five sponsors, and reset to defaults — all saved in local storage.
Share a link with the configuration in the URL, and the screen updates instantly — here, Cursor San Francisco, a custom heading, a fixed September date, and a twenty second replay interval.
Up to five sponsor entries appear under the date, each with a title and name, so partners stay on screen during the event.
Back in the editor, every sponsor slot, the custom date, and the replay interval are ready to tweak. Auto replay can also be turned off so the animation plays once.
Share copies a link with the current settings, so another host can open the same welcome screen without re-entering anything.
Keyboard shortcuts keep presentation smooth: E opens the editor, F or P toggles fullscreen, and Escape closes the sidebar or exits presentation mode.
Preview, or the F or P keys, enter fullscreen presentation mode and hide the toolbar and footer so the welcome can fill the room display.
A compact footer credits the maker and Cursor, and hides automatically when you go fullscreen.
